name: TIDAL
subtitle: A tundra world under three moons
lore: Three moons never leave the sky, and twice a day they lift the sea under the ice by a hand's width. For half of every day the sun is a rumour behind the clouds; the other half, three lights in the sky. Nothing here was easy, and nothing here was ever alone.
place: TUNDRA WORLD   ·   THREE MOONS   ·   K STAR
readiness: ready; the moon-of-a-giant version waits for the generator
